title: Encoded transition row
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean-valued tapes, let $c,B,e$ be natural numbers, and let $y$ be a Boolean list. Encode two pairs formed from the indicated first and second projections of $y$; zip the resulting list with the list obtained by encoding the first pair, apply the encoded transition-entry operation to corresponding entries, and sum the resulting list.
hypotheses_covered: N is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over Bool
c, B, and e are natural numbers
caveat: The payload does not include definitions of the projection, encoding, zip, entry, or list-sum operations.
